pii_classification_confirmed.title: PII Classification Status
pii_classification_confirmed.description: The confirmed classification state of the data with respect to PII presence. 'confirmed_pii' means PII is definitively present; 'confirmed_no_pii' means absence is verified; 'unclassified' means classification has not been formally performed or remains ambiguous. Used across all rule vectors requiring classification state.

mandatory_controls_enforced.title: Mandatory PII Controls Enforced
mandatory_controls_enforced.description: Indicates whether all mandatory handling controls for PII (encryption-at-rest, access restrictions, audit logging) are consistently enforced on this dataset. False means controls are optional, inconsistent, or not applied.

retention_boundary_defined.title: Retention Boundary Defined
retention_boundary_defined.description: Indicates whether a defined, bounded retention period and automated disposal procedure exists for this data. False means the data is stored indefinitely or with no enforced expiry, creating an unbounded exposure window. A label of 'temporary' without a specific time bound counts as undefined.

maximum_retention_period_defined.title: Maximum Retention Period Defined
maximum_retention_period_defined.description: Whether a specific, finite maximum retention period is formally defined for this temporary storage location (e.g., 24 hours, 7 days). Must be a concrete time-bound commitment, not a vague label like 'temporary'.

automated_expiry_mechanism.title: Automated Expiry Mechanism
automated_expiry_mechanism.description: The type of automated mechanism enforcing deletion or expiry of data in this temporary store. 'none' means no automated enforcement exists.

pii_anonymization_applied.title: PII Anonymization or Pseudonymization Applied
pii_anonymization_applied.description: Indicates whether anonymization, pseudonymization, or masking has been applied to data prior to or during temporary storage, such that raw personal identifiers are not retained in their original form.

pii_presence_confirmed.title: PII Presence Confirmation Status
pii_presence_confirmed.description: The confirmed determination of whether personally identifiable information is actually present in the temporarily stored data, based on data discovery, classification scanning, or schema inspection. 'confirmed_present' means PII is detected; 'confirmed_absent' means absence is verified; 'unclassified' means no scan has been performed or results are inconclusive.

retention_period_defined.title: Retention Period Explicitly Defined
retention_period_defined.description: Indicates whether a bounded, enforced retention or expiration policy is defined for the temporary storage location, preventing indefinite accumulation of raw data. False means the data is stored with no enforced expiry.

data_classification_status.title: Data Classification Status
data_classification_status.description: The confirmed classification state of the data asset — whether it has been formally classified, is pending classification, or is unclassified/unknown.

access_control_policy_applied.title: Access Control Policy Applied
access_control_policy_applied.description: Whether a sensitivity-tier-based access control policy (RBAC, ABAC, or equivalent) has been explicitly applied to this data asset or its storage location.

storage_retention_boundary_defined.title: Storage Retention Boundary Defined
storage_retention_boundary_defined.description: Whether an explicit retention or expiry policy with a bounded time window has been configured for the temporary storage location.

secure_disposal_procedure_defined.title: Secure Disposal Procedure Defined
secure_disposal_procedure_defined.description: Indicates whether a documented, verifiable disposal procedure (secure deletion or cryptographic erasure) is defined and linked to the retention policy for this transient data store.

server_jurisdiction.title: Server Jurisdiction
server_jurisdiction.description: The legal jurisdiction in which the server storing the temporary data resides, used to determine whether cross-border transfer regulations apply.

transfer_impact_assessment_completed.title: Transfer Impact Assessment Completed
transfer_impact_assessment_completed.description: Whether a Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) or equivalent cross-border transfer evaluation (e.g., GDPR Chapter V adequacy check, SCC evaluation) has been completed and documented for this data flow.
